name: AH 5720
title: Theory and Practice of Clinical Genomics
description: Theory and practice of diagnostic laboratory methodologies and genomic data analyses for the clinical scientist. Sections are taught in a series of modules and include clinical case scenarios and analyses. With a change of content, this course may be repeated for credit. May be repeated for a total of 18 credits.
requirement_description: Instructor consent. Recommended preparation: A course in human genetics.
